title: Setup
description: GET /api/setup : the home page's ways to connect a website (the sentence for a coding agent, in English, and the commands of `setup --print`), its example preview, and what has been recorded so far.

server.description: The On a server tab's three things for the subdomain route, one command or field per line, placeholders only: install (the commands that start AgentCake and Caddy from the release folder), dns (the record that points cake.<the site's domain> at the server) and settings (what AgentCake on the server is told, public_url among it).

recorded.description: At any time: the sessions the lists show, how many of them the website sent (all but those an earlier AgentCake's demo shop recorded: the website is connected once it has sent one), and how many are Agent sessions.
